mapper.select: select * from tb_user where openid = #{openid} and deleted = 0

SELECT user.id, user.username, user.realname, user.openid, user.head_img, user.sex, user.sex, user.phone, user.authentication, user.school_id, user.stu_id, user.student_id_card, user.student_id_card_review, user.score, user.money, user.alipay_payment_code, user.wechat_payment_code, user.is_manager, user.deleted, user.create_time, user.update_time FROM tb_user AS user WHERE user.id = #{currentId} AND user.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num FROM tb_user WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT tb_user.*, tb_school.`school_name` FROM tb_user, tb_school WHERE tb_user.deleted = 0 AND tb_user.student_id_card_review = 1 AND tb_user.`school_id` = tb_school.`id`

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.realname, u.head_img, u.sex, u.phone, s.school_name, u.stu_id, u.authentication, u.student_id_card_review, u.score, u.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE user_id = u.id AND deleted = 0) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders tk2 WHERE tk2.user_id = u.id AND tk2.deleted = 0) AS take_order_count FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_school s ON u.school_id = s.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.realname, u.head_img, u.sex, u.phone, s.school_name, u.stu_id, u.authentication, u.student_id_card_review, u.score, u.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE user_id = u.id AND deleted = 0) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders tk2 WHERE tk2.user_id = u.id AND tk2.deleted = 0) AS take_order_count FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_school s ON u.school_id = s.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.authentication = 1 ORDER BY u.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.realname, u.head_img, u.sex, u.phone, s.school_name, u.stu_id, u.authentication, u.student_id_card_review, u.score, u.student_id_card, u.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE user_id = u.id AND deleted = 0) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders tk2 WHERE tk2.user_id = u.id AND tk2.deleted = 0) AS take_order_count FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_school s ON u.school_id = s.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.student_id_card_review = 1 ORDER BY u.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.realname, u.head_img, u.sex, u.phone, s.school_name, u.stu_id, u.authentication, u.student_id_card, u.student_id_card_review, u.score, u.money, u.alipay_payment_code, u.wechat_payment_code AS weChatPaymentCode, u.is_manager, u.create_time, u.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE user_id = u.id AND deleted = 0) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_take_orders tk2 WHERE tk2.user_id = u.id AND tk2.deleted = 0) AS take_order_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o2.price), 0) FROM tb_take_orders tk2 INNER JOIN tb_orders o2 ON tk2.order_id = o2.id AND o2.deleted = 0 WHERE tk2.user_id = u.id AND tk2.deleted = 0) AS total_earned FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_school s ON u.school_id = s.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND authentication = #{authentication}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND student_id_card_review = #{studentIdCardReview}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND is_manager = 1
